priorityList: Maintain the Eradicate buff by using Void Ray if it is not active during AoE.
Cast Pierce the Veil if Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
At maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks, prioritize casting Voidblade followed by The Hunt.
Use Metamorphosis when the Eradicate buff is active.
Execute the Reap sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if Voidfall is active or if you have at least 4 souls consumed during Metamorphosis.
Cast Voidblade if Moment of Craving is active and you are at or near maximum Collapsing Star stacks.
Use Collapsing Star as a primary cooldown, especially if Predator's Wake is unavailable.
Use Vengeful Retreat whenever the Voidstep buff is active.
Cast Hungering Slash as your primary melee strike in AoE situations.
Use Reapers Toll if Voidsurge is active or against multiple targets.
Cast Pierce the Veil and Predators Wake on cooldown to maintain your melee combo.
Use Voidblade as a filler in your melee combo if you are in Metamorphosis or talented into Hungering Slash.
Maintain Soul Immolation on targets whenever Metamorphosis is not active.
Use Devour and Consume as final fillers to manage resources.
Sync your combat potions and trinkets with Metamorphosis for maximum burst damage.
